# cpio: man = cpio.1, src = src/cmd/cpio.c. Archives (a: ASCII -c, b: binary big-endian) are generated files of the cases; mtimes fixed by touch -d.

== out_bin
# man: -o writes names read from stdin as an archive to stdout
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -o
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'f1'
expect: exit 0

== out_c
# man: c writes the header as ASCII
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -oc
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains ' 70707'

== out_v
# man: v prints the file names while saving
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -ocv
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'f1'

== out_B
# man: B block of 5120 bytes
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -ocB
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_a
# man: a resets the access time
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -oca
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_dir
# man: directory entry saved with size 0
dir
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p dir; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' dir
step: cpio -oc
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_missing
# src: <name> ? for a file that cannot be opened
f1
nofile
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -oc
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'nofile'

== out_empty
# src: empty name list gives only the trailer

-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -oc
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_6
# man: -6 sixth edition filetype
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -oc6
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_extra_arg
# src: -o with an argument is usage
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -o x
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'Usage'
expect: exit 2

== out_binary_v
# src: binary and verbose
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
step: cpio -ov
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== out_link
# man: gelinkte Dateien im Archiv
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "linked\n" > f1
host: ln f1 f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1
step: cpio -oc
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== pass_basic
# man: -p copies files to a directory
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -p out
stdin: t.in
expect: file out/f1 contains 'hello'

== pass_v
# man: v prints the names
f1
f2
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -pv out
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'f1'

== pass_d
# man: d creates needed directories
sub
sub/s
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -pd out
stdin: t.in
expect: file out/sub/s contains 'x'

== pass_nod
# src: Cannot create without d
sub/s
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -p out
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0

== pass_m
# man: m keeps the mtime
f1
sub/s
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -pdm out
stdin: t.in
expect: exit 0
step: ls -l out/f1

== pass_l
# man: l links instead of copying
f1
sub/s
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out
step: cpio -pdl out
stdin: t.in
expect: file out/f1 contains 'hello'

== pass_u
# man: u overwrites unconditionally
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out; printf "zzz\n" > out/f1
step: cpio -pu out
stdin: t.in
expect: file out/f1 contains 'hello'

== pass_newer
# src: current <name> newer
f1
-- case
host: printf "hello\nworld\n" > f1
host: printf "second file\n" > f2
host: touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' f1 f2
host: mkdir -p sub; printf "x\n" > sub/s; touch -d '2020-01-02 03:04:05 UTC' sub/s sub
host: mkdir -p out; printf "zzz\n" > out/f1; touch -d '2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' out/f1
step: cpio -p out
stdin: t.in
expect: output contains 'newer'

expect: exit 0

# src: -p without directory is usage

== noargs
# src: no arguments
x
-- case

expect: exit 2

== noopt
# src: options without o|i|p
x
-- case
step: cpio -v
expect: output contains 'Options must include'
expect: exit 2

== nodash
# src: first argument without dash is usage
x
-- case
step: cpio o
expect: output contains 'Usage'
expect: exit 2

== badopt
# src: unknown option
x
-- case
step: cpio -z

expect: exit 2

== pr_rename
# src: -p with -r (no tty) is refused
x
-- case
step: cpio -pr out
expect: exit 2
